title: Install a specific macOS software update
summary: Download and install one specific update by name. Use this when you know exactly which update you want to apply.

steps.explain: Run the software update tool with the install flag and the name of the update you want to apply.

placeholders.name: UPDATE_NAME
placeholders.description: The exact name of the update as listed by 'softwareupdate --list'.

rollback.explain: There is no simple command to undo a software update. You may need to restore from a Time Machine backup if an update causes issues.

warnings: Installing updates can take a long time and may require a restart.
Ensure you have a backup before installing updates.
